newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tea prices fall at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices fall at Colombo auction.

text.p: Tea prices fell across the board at the Colombo auction on Wednesday as bigger quantities came on the market, brokers said.

Demand from the Commonwealth of Indepedent States, which sent prices soaring to record levels in recent months, was not as strong for high grown teas, while the CIS and some Middle Eastern buyers provided useful support for low growns.
Leafy low grown teas, the mainstay of the auction, were three to five rupees lower while most high growns also fell, brokers said.
Brokers Forbes and Walker said the anticipated gross auction average fell to 110.75 rupees ($1.94) per kg for the 5.3 million kg on offer as against 116.64 rupees last week.
The next auction is on November 12-13 where 5.4 million kg will be on offer.
